NORTH DAKOTA STATE PLANNING DIVISION
STATE CAPITOL-FOURTH FLOOR-BISMARCK, NORTH DAKOTA 58501 701 224-2818
May 22, 1972
STATE INTERGOVERNMENTAL CLEARINGHOUSE "LETTER OF CLEARANCE" ON PROJECT REVIEW IN CONFORMANCE WITH OMB CIRCULAR NO. A-95
TO: Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
Mr. R. E. Johnson Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U.S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Johnson:
The State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse has received and reviewed the document entitled: Draft Environmental Statement on H. R. 1311, Proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972.
This bill provides for the conservation, protection and propagation of endangered or possibly endangered species. The draft environmental statement describes the environment involved, defines the environmental impact of the bill, explains alternative actions as well as adverse effects and describes the implementation of the bill.
This document is in general conformance with the goals and objectives of the State and is not in conflict with any other State Plan on file with the Clearinghouse.
In compliance with Executive Order No. 48 and Office of Management and Budget Circular No. A-95, our office has reviewed this document and hereby gives clearance to it without comment.
Sincerely,
Miss Bonnie E. Austin
Bonne & Charlen
Associate Planner
